chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn Khālid al-Barqī, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
It is appropriate that the deceased be placed short of the grave for a little while, then bury him.

key_terms.وَارِهِ: bury him; conceal him in the grave
key_terms.يَنْبَغِي: it is appropriate; indicates a prescribed or recommended manner

ai.seo_question: How should the deceased be handled immediately before burial according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives an instruction concerning the burial of the deceased. It indicates that the deceased should be placed near the grave briefly before being interred, reflecting a prescribed funerary practice in Shia jurisprudence.
